name: hooks-precommit-gate
description: Ensures the pre-commit framework actually runs. PreToolUse on git commit/push: when the repo HAS a .pre-commit-config.yaml but the matching git hook is not installed (.git/hooks/pre-commit / pre-push missing), it blocks with "run pre-commit install"; it also blocks --no-verify, which would skip the framework. Silent in repos with no pre-commit config, so it adds zero friction elsewhere. Pairs with secrets-scan (whose enforcement lives in the pre-push hook). Cross-tool (Claude + Codex).
